P.name: Garden of Thorns
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Zyra''' spawns one or two {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} nearby that last for 30 seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area for 1 second.
P.description2: After 1 second, enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy ''Seeds'' by moving on top of them.
P.description3: '''Zyra''' can only have a total of 8 ''Seeds'' planted at a time, preserving {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} spawned by ''{{ai|Rampant Growth|Zyra}}'' over {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} spawned by ''Garden of Thorns''.

Q.name: Deadly Spines
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' sprouts thorny spines at the target location that appear after a {{fd|0.625}}-seconds delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.description2: If ''Deadly Spine'' hits a ''Seed'', it sprouts into a [[File:Zyra Deadly Spines Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Thorn Spitter]]'' that lasts for 8 seconds.

W.name: Rampant Growth
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' plants a {{as|Seed|buzzword}} at the target location that remains for 60 seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area, though decreasing in radius after 1 second. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds, enemy champions can destroy the {{as|Seed|buzzword}} by stepping on it, which {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them for 2 seconds.
W.description2: '''Zyra''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Seed'' charge, up to a maximum of 2. Killing an enemy generates 35% charge toward a ''Seed'', increased to 100% for large enemies and whenever scoring an enemy {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}.

E.name: Grasping Roots
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' shoots a surge of vines in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
E.description2: If ''Grasping Roots'' hits a ''Seed'', it sprouts into a [[File:Zyra Grasping Roots Render.png|20px|link=Zyra#Pets]] ''[[Zyra#Pets|Vine Lasher]]'' that lasts for 8 seconds.

R.name: Stranglethorns
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zyra''' summons a monstrous thicket at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit as it expands.
R.description2: After 2 seconds, the thicket snaps upward to {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies within for 1 second.
R.description3: ''{{ai|Garden of Thorns|Zyra|Plants}}'' hit by the thicket become enraged, restoring {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''current''' health}}}}, increasing their {{as|'''maximum''' health by 50%}}, gaining 25% increased [[size]] and refreshing their duration while the thicket expands. Additionally they attack in a flurry, launching two shots per attack, dealing {{ft|150% damage per flurry.|75% damage per shot.}}
